summary: RoyaLand Co Ltd., a Bermuda-domiciled foreign private issuer listed on OTCQB under RLNDF, furnished a Form 6-K annexing a November 3, 2026 press release. The release is operational, not transactional: it celebrates Savoia 1908 FC, the Company's Italian professional football club, reaching the Coppa Italia quarter-finals for the first time in 118 years after a 2-0 home win over Sorrento on October 27, 2026. It recounts three cup wins and October league results and previews a December 8 trip to defending champions Potenza. No securities, capital, ownership or corporate-structure event is disclosed; the filing is a routine current report on business developments with no special-situation relevance.
